description: Ministry of Higher Education - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. NO. 2067/15, adding conditions for degree programmes to the Colombo International Nautical & Engineering College (Pvt.) Ltd.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of regulations under the Universities Act, specifically adding new degree programs to a schedule with specified conditions. It constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it exercises powers vested by an existing Act (Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978) and creates subsidiary legislation. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory authority rather than focusing on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
